system.description:
An easily concealed weapon, very common, and lightning fast in the hands of a skilled user. Can also be used as a ranged weapon if the character uses the Athletics Ability properly.

Negative Traits: Short

Concealability: Pocket

Damage: One health level

Availability: Any

Special Ability - Speed: In close combat against any weapon with the Negative Traits Clumsy, Heavy, or Slow, the wielder may pre-empt the opponent's attacks and strike first in any turn, as long as he has the Melee Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
